title: Ladder 18b · Ambulāns cōgitō (true pyramids, free voices)
summary: The participle pyramid rewritten the Ladder 5 way: every line built from the line before, one bit at a time, up to a long peak and slowly down. Five sentences: Ambulāns cōgitō · Tē lentē loquentem intellegō · Verbum ā tē dictum nōn intellegō · Tē loquente, taceō · Lēctiōne fīnītā, ambulō. Then a review, one day, and the five again. English → Latin, then the Latin twice. Free voices (Jenny + Paola).
